description: Tool to update a record's data in Salesforce via UI API. Use when you need to modify field values on an existing record. Salesforce validation rules are enforced. Pass If-Unmodified-Since header to prevent conflicts.

allow_save_on_duplicate.description: If true, allows the record to be saved even if duplicate detection rules are triggered. Default is false.
allow_save_on_duplicate.title: Allow Save On Duplicate

api_name.description: The API name of the record's object type (e.g., 'Contact', 'Account', 'Lead'). Can be null or omitted for updates.
api_name.title: Api Name

fields.description: Map of field API names to their new values. Only include fields you want to update. Field names should use API names (e.g., 'FirstName', 'Email', 'CustomField__c'). Unspecified fields remain unchanged.
fields.title: Fields

if_unmodified_since.description: RFC 7231 date/time format. Makes the request conditional - server will only update if the record hasn't been modified since this timestamp. Returns 412 Precondition Failed if the record was modified after this date.
if_unmodified_since.title: If Unmodified Since

record_id.description: The unique 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID of the record to update.
record_id.title: Record Id

trigger_other_email.description: Case object only. If true, sends email notifications outside the organization. Default is false.
trigger_other_email.title: Trigger Other Email

trigger_user_email.description: Case and Lead objects only. If true, sends email notifications to users in the organization. Default is false.
trigger_user_email.title: Trigger User Email

use_default_rule.description: Case, Lead, and Account objects only. If true, applies assignment and auto-response rules. Default is false.
use_default_rule.title: Use Default Rule

name: update_record

FieldValue.description: Represents a field value with its display and actual value.

displayValue.description: The formatted/display value for the field.
displayValue.title: Display Value

FieldValue.title: FieldValue

available.description: Whether this record type is available to the current user.
available.title: Available

name.description: The name of the record type.
name.title: Name

recordTypeId.description: The ID of the record type.
recordTypeId.title: Record Type Id

UpdateRecordResponse.description:
Response from updating a Salesforce record via UI API.

Returns a RecordRepresentation object containing the updated record data.

apiName.description: The API name of the record's object type.
apiName.title: Api Name

childRelationships.description: Map of child relationship names to arrays of related records.
childRelationships.title: Child Relationships

eTag.description: Entity tag for optimistic concurrency control.
eTag.title: E Tag

fields.description: Map of field API names to FieldValue objects containing value and displayValue.
fields.title: Fields

id.description: The unique Salesforce ID of the record (15 or 18 characters).
id.title: Id

lastModifiedById.description: ID of the user who last modified the record.
lastModifiedById.title: Last Modified By Id

lastModifiedDate.description: Timestamp of when the record was last modified.
lastModifiedDate.title: Last Modified Date

systemModstamp.description: Timestamp of when the record was last modified by any user.
systemModstamp.title: System Modstamp

UpdateRecordResponse.title: UpdateRecordResponse
